class: reset recovery (no reset staging inside a native hard partition)

evidence.bound: wire rst_n = arst_n (bind.py: type is hard in wf_plan, 'delivered reset to the native hard partition'); 18 ot_dp_st banks (8 x W=1368 dfi_i, bout_*) take .rst_n(rst_n) directly; ~11k async RESETN pins on one net
evidence.path: arst_n -> input buf -> 8 serial BUFx16f (placement wire repair, ~40 ps + 36 ps wire each) -> RESETN; vclk ideal 250 ps, period 833 ps
evidence.contrast: gunit__t1 clock.landing_contract.collector_tree has relays/core_resets/local_reset_taps and its bound carries ot_dp_rrelay chains; phy__t1 clock has only layer, tap_*, no landing_contract; reset = {sync_stages 2, tap_um [4320,1226.88]}

rows.meaning: a kept ot_dp_rrelay tree under the existing reset tap: tap -> per-bank root relay -> leaf relays of <= 32 RESETN pins within 405 um of their flops (fstart_reset_delta.py leaf model); each stage is a synchronous relay, 1 extra cycle per level (boot holds rst_n >= 64 clk, so +2..3 cycles is legal); die wf_plan hard-partition reset depth raised by the same K

rows.set: one row per leaf relay group as fstart_reset_delta.py writes them (D from the bound relay of equal depth)
rows.alternative_if_tool_cannot_target_ot_dp_: extend fstart_reset_delta.py INST to the ot_dp_st pin-register banks

not_recommended: multicycle/false path on arst_n recovery: removal on the same net fails the other way and it hides an 11k-pin net
